featured_reviews.name: Sabera Kapasi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited to buy a whiteboard, markers and a whiteboard duster from this location. I specifically needed a magnetized whiteboard and after checking with many stores, this is the only one that had it ready to buy (other stores had to place a pre-order). On returning home, I noticed that the pens were all dry and the whiteboard plate was separating from the frame in many places. It has been 3 weeks since my purchase and the duster felt is releasing from the plastic holder.

Edit: I am now seeing that even the magnet on the board is poor quality. I have tried using several different types of magnet holders and even a light sheet of paper is not being held on the board.

There are several other shops nearby who would give you better quality items. I definitely feel like I was cheated and given older stock. Absolutely do not recommend this place!

owner.name: HS Mart | Your Partner in Art (Owner)

owner_posts.post_text: All Sharpie products are now available at HS Mart. Explore our complete range of permanent markers and writing tools, trusted for bold, long-lasting results. Visit our store or shop online through our website with Pan-India delivery.

We had an amazing experience participating in The Lil Flea! featured_reviews.name: Fatema Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: HS Mart is more than just a stationery store—it’s a place where quality, passion, and trust truly come together. Every product is authentic, the collection is thoughtfully curated, and the guidance you receive makes a real difference. You can feel the care they put into what they do. A truly reliable and heartwarming experience every time. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Kaveri Mahto
featured_reviews.review_text: Had visited HS Mart at Lil Flea and was honestly blown away. The collection was outstanding, with some of the best stationery and art products I’ve seen. Everything was genuine, thoughtfully displayed.

featured_reviews.name: Divya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Situated in Abdul Rehman Street this place is a bit difficult to find due to it's location. Also, it's located on the first floor.

Honestly, this place is like being in heaven for artists and art lovers alike. It has got all possible brands and all possible things that an artist needs and wants. The only problem that I found is that it is way too expensive.

Situated in Abdul Rehman, you would get the same products at the lowest price possible in nearby shops. No doubt that the brands you get here are quite difficult to find nearby but, if you are not really a brand specific shopper I would suggest you to walk down the street and you will get the exact same product at dirt cheap prices.

Also a thing that was a bit off-putting was the service provided. It felt like the staff was forced to help and showed the least amount of interest.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Zainab Yusuf Baugwala
featured_reviews.review_text: Top notch products recieved within 1 day of order placement. Loved the service and the products both.

featured_reviews.name: Srushti Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: Best place in mumbai for stationery items. Especially for rare professional artistic tools. Very very co-operative staff. Also get discounted price for all products. Best place for art lovers. I love to visit this place anytime. Also the ambience is good.

featured_reviews.name: ANIKET MAJI
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good and reasonable and affordable art supplies. Every art related thing is available here. Prices are low compared to your local market and discounts are more when you buy in bulk.

featured_reviews.name: Alpha Trader
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent place for stationery lovers of all types. The owner couple are extremely helpful & courteous. The product range is one of the finest in Mumbai. If you visit, you'll wind up buying some great stuff ! Great job guys 👍

featured_reviews.name: Shivam Varma
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Cool Breeze of Art Supplies. I been a regular visitor in this shop. And I must say  When it comes to Japanese Art Supplies they got each and every thing.Also you get the general pencil and Conte pencil.

They also have the premium pentel graphgear pencils that is literally a flex in artist but worth each penny.

For pens the micron and copic are evergreen the range never ends

If you are looking to munch for Copic Marker or refills or multiliner
Do make a visit.
